melder.nexus.acl.configurations.profiles.role: Factory module for reusable safe codegen ACL profile.
responsibilities: constructs one reusable ACL profile variant

melder.nexus.acl.configurations.profiles.label: SafeCodegenProfileStrategy
melder.nexus.acl.configurations.profiles.role: Bottom rung of the codegen posture ladder: the reviewed restrictive default.
responsibilities: build a FrameACLCodegenProfile whose frame, conduit and spell rules allow only query and bind-existing operations

bind room code through its capability rules - imports off, the dangerous builtins, unsafe reflection, dunder access and recursive codegen; its denials of linking, local creation, invocation and writes compile into the frame's published `allowed_commands`, which no room command checks (documented 0.2.8313; enforcement GitHub #338)
register by name as a preset so authoring starts from a reviewed posture, never an empty ruleset

hold a closed file posture (0.2.8270): `open` denied by its SAFE_DENIED_BUILTIN_NAMES rule and imports off, so `io`, `os` and `pathlib` are refused too - policy checked in the room's process, not isolation

edges_authored.why: This factory module constructs one reusable codegen ACL profile variant.
The safe codegen profile factory uses the shared denied-builtin tuple, SAFE_DENIED_BUILTIN_NAMES.
